text:
elaine: Quick kickoff for FlashLaunch microcampaign 1 experimental plan: test two credit mixes + one compact prompt kit + webinar CTA. Primary goal: 7-day product trial activation (first successful generation). Who picks up copy, tracking, and CRM routing?

ben: I can own tracking + event schema. Suggest canonical events: `signup_origin`, `flash_cohort`, `credit_alloc`, `prompt_kit`, `gen_first_success`, `followup_session`. Also `nudge_banner_shown` and `activation_goal_met`. Example payload: 
```
{ "uid": "...", "flash_cohort": "alpha_low50", "credit_alloc": 50 }
```

nina: Cohorts idea: alpha_low50 = 50 credits + core-kit, beta_high250 = 250 credits + pro-kit, gamma_control = baseline no extra credits. Split 60/20/20 randomization where signup path = docs, blog, webinar. Primary KPI: activation_goal_met within 7 days. Secondary: retention to 14 days.

derek: Copy drafts (two social variants + CTA microcopy):
- Snappy: "FlashLaunch is live 1 grab credits & starter prompts to prototype AI features in minutes. See a demo in our kickoff webinar. -> [link]"
- Narrative: "Try FlashLaunch: get instant credits and curated prompt kits to jumpstart feature ideas. Well demo product use-cases in a short webinar 1 reserve your spot. -> [link]"
Email microcopy: "Your FlashLaunch credits are ready. Run a starter prompt and see immediate outputs. Prefer live help? Save a seat at the webinar."

elaine: For link tagging, please use UTMs: `utm_campaign=flashlaunch_q1&utm_source=social&utm_medium=post`. Derek, use CTA text "Save my seat" on webinar links (historically stronger).

ben: Il add experiment flags: `flash_exposed=true` on user record and push tracking to analytics. Will include `credit_tier` enum with values `low50`, `high250`, `control`. Timeline: schema ready Thu EOD, flags live Fri morning.

nina: Sampling logic: we should randomize at signup with deterministic hash on user_id so reassignments don't flip. Target N per cohort: 4k total across channels (approx 2400/800/800). Ill share allocation script.

derek: Also recommend a 3-email webinar nurture: day before (reminder), 1 hour before (last call), and post-webinar follow-up with usage tips and prompt examples. Include quickstart link that auto-applies credits.

elaine: Ops asks checklist:
- @ben: push schema + flags (due Thu EOD)
- @derek: finalize 2 social variants + 3-email copy (due Wed noon)
- @nina: confirm allocation & sampling script (due Wed EOD)
- @elaine: create campaign in CRM and add UTM checklist (due Wed EOD)
Run window: 14 days with snapshot at day 14 (activation_rate, avg_tokens_first_week, 14-day retention).

ops-bot: Campaign record created: `marketing::flashlaunch_q1` and calendar reminder set for 1887664200.

elaine: Thanks team 1 Ill drop a short brief + creative slots in the drive and ping contributors when assets are live. :rocket:
